verdict.rationale:
PlanetScale documents a 'self-improving database' feature where an agent autonomously reviews production Insights and schema recommendations on a recurring schedule, then opens pull requests with performance improvements, plus webhook events for automation triggers. This matches the story of autonomous background automation, but evidence is first-party only.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the self-improving agent actually runs unattended in production, and details on configuring/scheduling the automation beyond the doc description.
